knowledge_point.title: Finding an Entry of a Matrix

question.:question/problem:
Find the entry ${f}_{21}$ of the matrix $F$, where 

$$
F=\begin{bmatrix}-4 & 7 \\ -7 & -6 \\ -9 & 1\end{bmatrix}.
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The entry ${f}_{21}$ should lie at the intersection of the $2$nd row and $1$st column. Therefore, ${f}_{21}=-7.$

$$
F=\begin{bmatrix}-4 & 7 \\ -7 & -6 \\ -9 & 1\end{bmatrix}
$$
